cues.en: Come to Section three training a supervised learning model.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第三章：訓練監督式學習模型。

cues.en: This is Lecture 11 Training and Xgboost model.
cues.zh: 這是第十一堂課：訓練 XGBoost 模型。

cues.en: So this section is an attempt to build upon the initial work we did with the logistic regression where
cues.zh: 這一節要延續我們先前使用邏輯斯迴歸所做的工作，

cues.en: in a supervised learning context, a logistic regression model acts as a very good baseline effectively.
cues.zh: 因為在監督式學習中，邏輯斯迴歸是非常好的基準模型。

cues.en: But often once we've built a baseline, what we'd like to do is to iteratively, iteratively build more
cues.zh: 不過，建立基準模型後，我們通常會逐步嘗試

cues.en: complex models up until the point that we can prove that the additional complexity does provide better performance from a classification perspective.
cues.zh: 更複雜的模型，直到能證明增加的複雜度，確實讓分類效能變得更好。

cues.en: If not, then by all means default to your logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，那就繼續使用邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: Because if it's simple to implement and it gives you good enough performance and it runs pretty fast, you can interpret it quite easily, then you know, it makes sense to stick with that.
cues.zh: 畢竟，如果它容易實作、效能已足夠、執行速度快，而且容易解釋，就很值得繼續使用。

cues.en: Simpler is better.
cues.zh: 愈簡單愈好。

cues.en: But if it's a high stakes game and it's worth, you know, the additional complexity because you get those additional performance gains, you know, from a classification perspective or whatever else,
cues.zh: 但如果情境牽涉重大損失，而增加複雜度能換來額外的分類效能或其他好處，

cues.en: then then obviously it if you can equate it to to a monetary value or something like that, then potentially it makes sense to to look at more complex approaches.
cues.zh: 而且能把這些改善換算成金錢等價值，那麼研究更複雜的方法，就可能有意義。

cues.en: And one of those that does work very well on tabular data is Xgboost, which is a popular and efficient open source.
cues.zh: 其中一種對表格資料效果很好的方法，就是 XGBoost。它是一種常用、高效率的開源

cues.en: Implementation of the gradient boosted trees algorithm and gradient boosting is essentially a supervised
cues.zh: 梯度提升樹演算法實作。梯度提升本質上是監督式

cues.en: learning algorithm, and it attempts to accurately predict a target variable like we've been doing with
cues.zh: 學習演算法，和邏輯斯迴歸一樣，目的都是準確預測目標變數，

cues.en: logistic regression by combining the estimates of a set of simpler, weaker models.
cues.zh: 但它是透過結合一組較簡單、較弱模型的估計結果來達成。

cues.en: So it aggregates in an ensemble way, a bunch of simple, weaker models to make an overall meta decision, right?
cues.zh: 也就是用集成方式，彙整多個簡單的弱模型，做出整體決策。

cues.en: So I've pip installed Xgboost onto my machine.
cues.zh: 我已經在電腦上用 pip 安裝 xgboost。

cues.en: I'm importing it as xgboost and it has the same API interface as what we used to seeing within scikit learn.
cues.zh: 現在將它匯入為 xgboost；它的 API 介面和 scikit-learn 常用的介面相同。

cues.en: So it works on the same premise as you know, once you've initialized a model class, you can then train
cues.zh: 原理也一樣，先初始化模型類別，再利用 fit

cues.en: the model by using.fit, specifying our training features as well as our training target variable.
cues.zh: 方法，指定訓練特徵與訓練目標變數，來訓練模型。

cues.en: We train the model and then we can say model dot predict on the unseen test data to make the classifications.
cues.zh: 訓練完成後，呼叫 model.predict，針對未見的測試資料進行分類。

cues.en: We can make use of the confusion matrix like we did for the logistic regression.
cues.zh: 也可以像邏輯斯迴歸那樣使用混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And I've applied the same confusion matrix to print out the overall results.
cues.zh: 我套用了同樣的混淆矩陣，輸出整體結果。

cues.en: If I make this a little bit smaller.
cues.zh: 把顯示尺寸縮小一點，

cues.en: We can see the full picture here.
cues.zh: 就能看到完整圖表。

cues.en: So if we recall, we still had quite a few false positives with the improved logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 回想一下，改善後的邏輯斯迴歸模型，仍有不少偽陽性。

cues.en: We were able to detect 44 fraudulent cases and here we've got slightly less.
cues.zh: 它能偵測到 44 筆詐欺案例，而這裡稍微少一點。

cues.en: So we've got 40, but we've got very few false positives, only two of them.
cues.zh: 現在偵測到 40 筆，但偽陽性非常少，只有兩筆。

cues.en: So that might be a very good trade off.
cues.zh: 這可能是個很好的取捨。

cues.en: The model's, you know, very accurate from that perspective.
cues.zh: 從這個角度看，模型相當準確。

cues.en: But, you know, maybe we're not satisfied with these nine cases that we weren't able to detect.
cues.zh: 不過，我們可能不滿意仍有九筆詐欺沒有偵測出來。

cues.en: So there's obviously room for us to improve this potentially.
cues.zh: 因此，顯然還有可能改善。

cues.en: Recall that this is just a baseline logistic xgboost classifier that we implementing.
cues.zh: 別忘了，目前實作的只是基準 XGBoost 分類器。

cues.en: We haven't done any hyperparameter optimization.
cues.zh: 我們還沒有做任何超參數最佳化。

cues.en: And as you can see with this model object, there are quite a few hyper parameters that are at our disposal
cues.zh: 而從這個模型物件可以看出，它提供了相當多的超參數，

cues.en: that we are able to optimize.
cues.zh: 可以讓我們調整並最佳化。

cues.en: That's another whole art and science on its own hyper parameter optimization.
cues.zh: 超參數最佳化本身就是一門學問。

cues.en: There are open source tools that allow you to iteratively find the best combination of different hyper parameters to give you your optimal model.
cues.zh: 有一些開源工具，能讓你反覆搜尋最佳的超參數組合，以取得最佳模型。

cues.en: We won't be exploring that here, but what we will be doing is just focusing on the hyper parameters that make sense from a class imbalance perspective.
cues.zh: 這裡不會深入探討，而是只專注在與類別不平衡有關、較值得調整的超參數。
